goal: Full original Ragebot and its necessary transitive dependencies as readable C17.
current_implementation_language: C++17 (bounded offline modules); archived partial C helpers also exist.
state_semantics: ready means assignable bounded work, not implemented functionality; done never auto-closes a full GAP.

tasks.title: C17 pilot: scalar helper
tasks.bounded_deliverable: One C17 helper preserving the existing bounded contract and explicit optional fallback; no provider reconstruction.
acceptance: Strict C17 compilation by a C compiler; coordinator integrates build targets.
Native and ASan/UBSan; NaN, signed zero, ordering and missing fallback cases.
Bitwise differential checks against C++ within its documented domain; keep original tests.
Fixed-SHA peer review; no claim of equivalence to the original binary.

tasks.title: C17 N layout, storage, update and reader
tasks.blocked_reason: C01 must establish the accepted C API/build/test pattern first.
tasks.bounded_deliverable: Port only the accepted N contract with explicit ownership and statuses; not target aggregation.
acceptance: C17 layout/size assertions and all existing bounded cases.
C/C++ state and bit comparisons, including unchanged bytes and outside-supported-domain results.
Native/sanitizer checks and peer review.

tasks.title: C17 local charge state
tasks.bounded_deliverable: Port local capacity/latch/gate/reset projection, not an invented complete automaton.
acceptance: Raw AL values 0, 1, 2, 3, 254, 255 and branch semantics retained.
No assumed reset scheduling; compare only supported state projections.
C17/native/sanitizer checks and peer review.

tasks.title: C17 lifecycle and scalar compositions
tasks.blocked_reason: Requires accepted C scalar helper and N representation.
tasks.bounded_deliverable: Port current producer/consumer/optional output and two compositions; coordinator may split into disjoint child tasks.
acceptance: Per-call observations, consumer bypasses, bounded aliases, float order and byte preservation retained.
Unresolved rollback labelled as offline API convention, not original behavior.
C17/native/sanitizer and C++ regression/differential checks; fixed-SHA review.

tasks.title: Transitive scope and evidence coverage map
tasks.bounded_deliverable: Map every domain of the full goal to existing code/evidence/unknowns; propose bounded next cards for aggregation, geometry, modes and network gaps. No new aggregation or T+68 implementation in this card.
acceptance: Each row has concrete source paths/anchors or explicit unknown, plus dependencies.
Keep N and T distinct; inventory does not close CODE01/GAP02.
Read-only archive checks and independent review of scope coverage.

tasks.title: One first-positive-source hypothesis
tasks.bounded_deliverable: Before assignment select exactly one field among Point+26, T+F4 and G425009BC and one new byte-supported hypothesis; produce a typed source chain or exact frontier.
acceptance: Record selected field/hypothesis in assignment before work.
Prove object identity, width, flow and conditions; negative search is not proof of absence.
Fresh pinned byte checks and review; no synthetic positive-value stub.

tasks.title: One scalar external-observation provider
tasks.bounded_deliverable: Select one fallback or tolerance observation and trace a bounded typed dependency; do not claim complete runtime bindings.
acceptance: Exact caller/provider anchors and explicit assumptions.
Separate repeated reads over time; identify unresolved lifetime/alias/guard boundaries.
Static verifier and review; no runtime hook or original-image execution.

tasks.title: N+14 P/P+0 frontier
tasks.blocked_reason: No new byte-level basis beyond the accepted W3 frontier; do not repeat broad searches.
tasks.bounded_deliverable: Only after new concrete byte-level evidence: investigate one P supplier/lifetime/P+0-writer hypothesis.
acceptance: Coordinator records the new evidence and bounded window before unblocking.
Same-offset or same-global-address observations alone are insufficient.
Do not infer positivity, reachability or cross-call identity from the immediate writer.

tasks.title: One charge reset condition or remaining store
tasks.bounded_deliverable: Select one entry predicate or one of the unmodelled reset stores and establish a bounded contract/frontier.
acceptance: Exact memory identity, branch condition, effects and width.
No assumed invocation order or full state-machine closure.
Fresh byte evidence and independent review.

tasks.title: One remaining historical H01 gate
tasks.bounded_deliverable: Choose one of the 12 historical-only entries; reproduce its actual gate if supported, otherwise record a concrete blocker. Do not rebuild all tooling blindly.
acceptance: Read old scripts before execution; do not modify archival inputs/evidence.
Commands, versions, SHA, exit codes and sanitized logs; no relabelled historical PASS.
Do not call agent review an external audit or substitute a different test for the old protocol.

tasks.title: Integrated bounded C17 library acceptance
tasks.blocked_reason: C ports and transitive scope inventory not yet accepted.
tasks.bounded_deliverable: Coordinator integrates the C ports and bounded pipeline with an independent fixed-SHA acceptance; not the complete Ragebot.
acceptance: C library builds as C17 without a C++ runtime dependency.
Existing C++ make check plus native/sanitized C tests and differential harness.
Input integrity unchanged; independent code/evidence and reproducibility reviews.

tasks.title: Full-project completion gate, not a single-agent assignment
tasks.blocked_reason: Full tasks remain open/partial; no full C port, full behavioral proof or external audit.
tasks.bounded_deliverable: Close the actual complete transitive Ragebot contour in readable C, including tasks discovered by R01 and later evidence; no claim that the listed bounded cards alone suffice.
acceptance: All criteria in docs/GOAL.md met; no critical unknown providers, branches or placeholder logic.
Complete dependency/mode/environment map and reproducible behavioral protocol.
Independent external audit and original-equivalence obligations actually satisfied, or completion remains blocked.
